data.name: Biopower Tana
data.description: Biopower Tana AS is a Norwegian biochar developer founded in 2020, based in Austertana, Finnmark, and owned by Unni Sekkesæter since October 2022. The company plans to convert local residual biomass (forestry waste, dairy, slaughterhouse and fish-farm residues) into biochar-based fertilizer, with carbon credit sales via Puro.earth through a partnership with Accend. The first plant was planned for commissioning in Austertana in 2025, with future expansion planned to Børøya in Norway and sites in Thailand.
